scope.included: Scythe 2016 base/core multiplayer for 2–5 players, full exact frozen candidate material rules and important omissions.
scope.method: Read the full new candidate and revalidate throughout against the complete authoritative source previously read in this continuing source-only review. Re-read PDF pp. 7, 22 for the new information table. Production, mat/recruit, all six structure tiles and final scoring diagrams have been visually inspected in this review. No question banks, keys, readers, grades, coverage or other reports accessed; candidate and earlier files preserved.

checked_claims.topic: Public hand count and combat commitment concealment
checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: Information table accurately combines public combat-card hand count with explicit permission during combat to conceal whether any cards were committed until simultaneous reveal. Card contents remain secret until revealed. This does not permit changing commitment after reveal or skipping mandatory card discard; numbered combat procedure remains consistent.
Secret objective contents until completed objective revealed; coins not hidden information, yet player never required to reveal total coin value. New table preserves these distinctions.

Read every section of exact candidate, reviewed quantities, cost/benefit order, destinations, legality, all faction abilities, six structure diagrams, combat/encounter/Factory interactions, ending and scoring. No important in-scope omission found.

Five faction/player mats, six structure tiles, correct faction piece counts and combat unit types; greatest fortune wins, individual clockwise turns without rounds, immediate sixth-star end regardless of winner.

Correct shuffles, players+1 Factory cards with unused unseen, random face-up structure tile, eleven encounter tokens, supply, random mats/seating, starting tracks/cards/coins from correct mats and two objectives, starting board and mat piece locations, empty one-time recruit spaces, lowest numbered mat starts.

Different section except Rusviet, optional top then bottom once each, either/both/neither; full exposed red cost before optional green benefit, top gains may fund bottom, dead turns, bottom-choice turn overlap appropriate.

Bases never territories, normal entry/build/deploy restrictions and setup/retreat/Wayfare exceptions; unit or own structure without enemy unit controls, enemy worker controls occupied building/resources, owner keeps abilities except uncontrolled Mill, defender temporary control; four resources only, workers excluded, spend any controlled resources remotely to supply, tokens stay on board otherwise, unlimited supply and friendly stacking.

Two different sequential units one step or one coin before upgrades; all carry resources, only mechs workers, carried workers retain independent move; default river/lake restrictions, adjoining shore lake rule, tunnel adjacency and personal Mine even enemy controlled with normal entry restrictions; worker hostile-entry restrictions and enemy-structure-only entry; Speed additional plastic-unit step and intermediate load/unload.

Enemy worker/plastic entry stops unit, encounter stops character for turn; undefended workers immediately home leaving resources, one popularity each even insufficient, no combat; full Move then attacker-ordered combats then encounter before subsequent bottom, lost contested encounter leaves token.

One coin for two power or one card before upgrade, combat deck shuffle/exhaustion; one coin for two arbitrary resources or one popularity, resources on controlled worker territory and no resource Trade when all workers at home; correct Monument/Armory additions.

Full current exposed cost before production; up to two distinct controlled territories before upgrade; per-worker matching terrain token at producing territory, metal/mountain oil/tundra food/farm wood/forest worker/village and none/lake or Factory. New workers left-to-right after payment, optional and permanent, new costs apply later.

Controlled Mill is extra production territory and one worker-equivalent output, actual workers also produce, Mill works without actual worker. Current allowance two plus Mill gives up to three territories; upgraded three plus Mill gives up to four. No duplicate production or new resource type authorized, and control/terrain restrictions retained.

Upgrade oil, Deploy metal, Build wood, Enlist food; full exposed mat quantities/costs before gains, optional coins, completed paid action still grants coins/recruits, announce action. Upfront Upgrade effect correctly top benefit plus bottom reduction; pay first then green cube to empty bracketed red, not solid-border red.

Normal placement controlled worker territory, no lake or home-base, ability all mechs and character not workers; one structure total per territory including opponents, Factory allowed, permanence/no enemy use; Armory power on Trade, Monument popularity on Bolster, Mill control exception, Mine personal tunnel including Factory movement even enemy occupied.

Any recruit to any empty permanent one-time slot for two power/coins/popularity/cards; ongoing original section one power Upgrade, coin Deploy, popularity Build, card Enlist; self/immediate neighbors matching bottom only, active-left-right priority, two-player once, top/Factory/encounter exclusions, sixth-star halts later resolution.

Rusviet repeats including Factory; Crimea one card once per turn as one resource regardless of value; Nordic workers river cross not lakes; Polania up to two different options from one encounter any order, first may fund second; Saxony available stars unlimited combat/objectives and retains other objective.

checked_claims.topic: Nordic and Crimea other mech abilities
checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: Seaworthy lake movement/optional adjacent-lake retreat incl carried workers, Artillery pay one to remove two opponent power once per combat; Wayfare own/inactive bases incl expansion not active enemies, Scout one random card stolen before combat once per combat.

Submerge to/from lakes and any lake to another; Camaraderie only aggressive combat victory, not undefended displacement; no abandoned resources/workers in lake, workers need mech to leave; no lake build/deploy, possible lake battles, no Polania Nordic-style retreat exception.

Zero power/popularity initiation, attacker ability first, secret simultaneous dial 0..min(7,current), optional card per plastic plus Rusviet even zero dial, reveal simultaneously, attacker ties; both pay dial track amount and discard every used card face-up, card values no additional track loss.

Winner controls territory/resources and mandatory eligible star, ordinary two combat cap versus Saxony and further combats legal; loser all units home leaving resources with Nordic exception; attacker-only worker popularity penalty incl carried lake workers, defender none, Polania exception; loser one card if positive power via dial/cards, zero total none; pending attacks undone on sixth star.

Character-only encounters after full Move/all combats, show card/art and thematic capitals aloud, affordable required choice except Polania, full cost and optional benefits, all gains at encounter, no normal cost/mat/recruit extras, card face-down under deck; every characters first Factory finish must choose one permanent card/no switch, fifth section optional top then bottom with normal repeat/Rusviet, no corresponding mat benefits, bottom one unit two steps or Speed plastic three with ordinary stops/Mine.

Own-turn reveal before/after top/bottom with all requirements at reveal, may defer, usual one star and both cards bottom-deck versus Saxony retention; unenforceable deals, only tangible coins and tournament restriction, no cancellation of initiated combat.

Six upgrades, four mechs/buildings/recruits, eight workers, objective, combat up to two, popularity eighteen and power sixteen; permanent/unblocked, ordinary once except combat/Saxony; sixth immediate no equalizing turns, finish bottom primary/coins/own ongoing before ending star, neighbor active-left-right with cutoff, unresolved mixed attacks undone.

checked_claims.topic: Final fortune and six structure diagrams
checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: Held coins plus popularity rates 0–6 3/2/1, 7–12 4/3/2, 13–18 5/4/3 for stars/territories/pairs. Factory three total, each other territory incl lake one, no bases, sum before rate; resource pairs pooled floor, no workers/cards. Adjacent tunnels 1/2–3/4–5/6 pay 2/4/6/9; lakes/encounters 1/2–3/4–5/6–7 same; on tunnels 1/2/3–4 pay 2/4/6; longest straight row and combined farms/tundra 1/2/3/4 pay 2/4/6/9. Unique adjacent features, Mine excluded, removed encounters count, rivers do not break adjacency/row, enemy-control structures still score, zero features zero. Tie order workers+mechs+structures, power, popularity, resources, territories, stars.

important_omission_review: No important in-scope omission found after the full-candidate review. Physical mat-dependent values are explicitly read from exposed boxes; omission of exhaustive global inventory, combat-card frequencies, narrative/strategy and optional teaching demonstrations is appropriate to a summary.
limitations: Source-only audit against supplied base rulebook; no external FAQ, later revision or component-card corpus checked.
conclusion: PASS for the exact candidate-repair-06 hash recorded. New public/hidden information table correctly preserves public hand count with combat commitment concealment until reveal, secret card/objective contents and coin disclosure rule. No material contradiction or important core multiplayer omission found.
